scope: Isolated integration of segmented FIFO WorkQueue and reclamation-sensitive upstream Loom probes
selection: WorkQueue/WorkStealer and regression in queue.rs, SegQueue probe generator and two model/ledger files. PendingWork and other pre-existing changes excluded via temporary index; worktree file untouched.
review: SegQueue reserves head before reading. Each non-final consumer publishes READ after its payload access. Block::destroy defers through DESTROY to unfinished consumers; the final consumer resumes destruction. Before the physical free, the probe checks READ for all non-final slots using Relaxed loads. The guard prevents executing an unsafe free in the deliberately broken control.
probe_commands: python3 tools/probe_segmented_work_loom.py --source <cached-crossbeam-queue-0.3.13> --output <new-directory> --lap <4|32> [--premature-retirement]; cargo generate-lockfile --offline --manifest-path <directory>/Cargo.toml; cargo test --manifest-path <directory>/Cargo.toml --offline --locked --lib. Negative runs filter slots::drop_once_across_retirement_and_abandoned_tail -- --exact. DEV/TEST DEBUG=0 and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0.
negative_control: Replace the deferring return in Block::destroy with break. Both sizes fail the pre-free guard: premature segment release: consumer has not published READ.
environment: Initial gate attempt exhausted disk and linker aborted. Removed historical generated delivery builds, retained logs/evidence, and repeated complete gate successfully.
limits: Five bounded models and state preconditions, not general weak-memory/liveness proof. Raw block pointer validity is not fully instrumented. WorkStealer replaces the public deque-specific handle; FIFO and unbounded push remain, steal returns Success/Empty. This delivery does not establish global mutation, hardware measurements, publication or closure of all specs.
